# TruVoice back end (C)

The engine behind the front end: TextIn, Stage0 to Stage3, the frame builder and the synthesiser. It is adapted from
**OpenTV** (`..\tv-decomp-main`), RetroBunn's C decompilation of the sibling build `CGRM_EN.DLL`. OpenTV's MIT
licence and notice are not carried: like this project, it derives from decompiled proprietary code (AGENTS.md,
licence decision). OpenTV's own extensions to the engine (the rate rows above the original's table, and the
bandwidth widening it took from TGSpeechBox) are removed; its 16 kHz output rate remains, unused by TruVoice. The plan and the reasons for this approach are in AGENTS.md (TODO 13), and
the findings are in REFERENCE.md §9.

## Where the files come from
`tools/backend/retarget.py` imported OpenTV's `src/` here (commit `bce8f54`). The source was the download in
`..\tv-decomp-main` as of 2026-09-28, which has no revision id. The script copied the tree and changed only the
address annotations. Every `/* @0x… */`, and the comments that name an address, give the **TV_ENG32 address**
instead of the CGRM one.
- Since then the files have been changed for TruVoice (steps 3 and 4, marked `TV_ENG32` in the code) and three OpenTV
  bugs have been fixed (REFERENCE §9.6). So the script **must not be rerun**: it would overwrite them.
- `engine.fields` is generated by `tools/backend/gen_layout.py`.
- `engine/g711.c`, `port/truvoice.*`, `port/email.c` and `port/tvsay.c` are new.

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `engine/*.c`, `engine.h` | OpenTV's engine, 26 files, with TV_ENG32's versions of the functions listed under step 3. `engine/g711.c` (TV only) is the µ-law / A-law encoder. `engine/sapi.c` is CGRM's SAPI glue and is not built |
| `crt.h`, `port/msvcrt.c` | the MSVC 4.2 CRT pieces the engine uses |
| `engine.fields` | the **TV_ENG32** engine object layout (0x93d0 bytes), written by `tools/backend/gen_layout.py` from OpenTV's; the evidence per field is in `tools/backend/layout.txt` (REFERENCE §9.2) |
| `port/truvoice.c`, `port/truvoice.h` | **TruVoice's driver**: `tts_SaveFile` 1005fb50, `BuildEscapePrefix` 1005f240, `SaveFile_Synthesize` 10001990 (REFERENCE §9.3). `tv_engine_step` runs engine steps one at a time, each engine with its own Stage 2 state, which TV_ENG32 shares between engines (REFERENCE §10.7) |
| `port/email.c` | the email context of `tts_SaveFile`: `Text_MaskHighChars` 1005e830, the front end (`src/frontend`, linked in by `build.sh`) and the `ESC[7F ESC[8F` … `ESC[7N ESC[8N` wrapping (REFERENCE §9.7). One call at a time: the front end's buffers are static |
| `port/userdic.c` | the user dictionary file (`UserDic_Load` 100257c0, `UserDic_Save` 100273a0's writing, find / delete / clear) over the engine's user lexicon; the replacement DLL uses it (REFERENCE §10.6) |
| `port/tvsay.c` | the command line: `tvsay [-0] [-t] "text\|@file" out.wav [ctx [options]]`, the arguments of `tools/probe/tvwav.exe` minus the DLL. ctx 1 = email context. `-0`: the front end without its fixes, as TV_ENG32; `-t`: write the engine's text instead of audio |
| `port/stubs.c` | OpenTV's `ByteList_Append` |
| `port/tvtts.c`, `port/main.c` | OpenTV's SAPI-style flat API and command line; not built (its extension switches no longer switch anything) |
| `ADDRESSES.tsv` | every annotated symbol: name, kind, CGRM address, TV_ENG32 address, how it was matched |

## Building and comparing
```sh
sh tools/backend/build.sh                                                   # -> build/backend/tvsay.exe
python tools/backend/compare.py ../tv-decomp-main/tests/corpus/01_basic.txt   # against TV_ENG32.DLL (tvwav.exe)
python tools/backend/compare.py -l tools/probe/tests_rules.txt                # one input per line
python tools/backend/compare.py -c 1 -j 8 -l tools/probe/tests_patent.txt     # email context, 8 at a time
python tools/backend/compare.py -t -c 1 -b -j 10 -l tools/fediff/corpus_email.txt   # engine text only, fediff lines
```
- `build.sh` also builds the replacement DLL, `build/backend/dll/TV_ENG32.DLL` (`src/dll/`).
- `compare.py` options: `-d DLL` to run the replacement DLL through `tvwav.exe` instead of `tvsay`, `-c 1` for the email context, `-t` to compare the text the engine gets (from
  `tools/probe/tvtext.exe`) and not the audio, `-b` for fediff test lines (`|` = CR LF), `-j N` for parallel runs,
  and `-f` for the front end with its fixes (by default `tvsay -0` runs, as TV_ENG32).
- `build.sh` uses the 32-bit winlibs gcc. It takes the engine's tables out of `TV_ENG32.DLL` at build time
  (`tools/backend/otv/gen_data.py`, OpenTV's), so no extracted data is committed.
- `compare.py` compares whole WAV files and caches the DLL's output in `build/backend/oracle/`.
- `build.sh` also builds the hook harness, `build/backend/hook/tvhook.exe`. It runs this C inside TV_ENG32.DLL, and in
  shadow mode it compares every call of every function with the original (`tools/backend/hook/README.txt`,
  REFERENCE §9.6):
  ```sh
  python tools/backend/hook/shadow.py -l tools/probe/tests_backend.txt ../tv-decomp-main/tests/corpus/01_basic.txt
  ```

## Address map (step 1, done)
All 557 annotated addresses are mapped: 251 functions and 306 data symbols.
- **Functions:** 248 have a TV_ENG32 match, from `tools/otv_match`. Of these, 67 are exact, 86 match by shape,
  32 fuzzily, 22 through the call graph and 41 from `gmatch.py` (REFERENCE §8.2).
- **Data:** 304 are placed. 201 match by content (`dmatch.py`); 77 are placed by cross-reference, from the code and
  pointers of matched functions; 26 are glide-table records placed as whole blocks by content (`dxref.py`).
  REFERENCE §9.5 has the method and its caveats.
- **No counterpart:** 5 symbols, written as `/* @none cg:0x… */`. `Engine_SetVoice`, `Sapi_PhoneNotify`,
  `g_voice_names` and `g_mode_info` are SAPI only. `tv_sscanf` is not used by TruVoice's CRT.

## Status
- [x] 1. Addresses moved to TV_ENG32.
- [x] 2. TV_ENG32 engine layout (`engine.fields`): every field placed, 13 TruVoice-only fields added, 4 SAPI fields
  dropped, `in_seg` has 20 entries.
- [x] 3. TruVoice driver and a standalone build (2026-09-29).
  - `port/truvoice.c` is the driver.
  - These are TV_ENG32's versions (REFERENCE §9.3):
    - `Engine_Construct`, `Engine_Reset` (with its argument) and `Engine_Step` (`engine.c`);
    - `Engine_Feed` (`feed.c`);
    - `Engine_RunControl` (`control.c`);
    - `Synth_Generate`'s output stage (`generate.c`, `Synth_PutSample`) and `g711.c`;
    - `Stage3_Phone` without the SAPI notification (`stage3.c`);
    - `Engine_MidPut` / `Engine_ResetRings` (`mid_wrapped`).
  - Results at that point: 17 of the 44 corpus files and 72 of the 82 test lines are byte-identical to TV_ENG32, WAV header
    included (REFERENCE §9.4).
- [x] 4. Hook harness over TV_ENG32, and the remaining functions fixed (2026-09-29, REFERENCE §9.6).
  - TruVoice's versions: `Stage4_Run` (`stages.c`), `Stage2_Begin` and `Stage2_Break` (`stage2.c`), `Stage3_Hold`
    (`stage3.c`), `Stage1_Pronounce` (`stage1.c`), `Engine_SetVolume` (`engine.c`).
  - OpenTV bugs fixed: `Stage3_Op7` and `Stage3_Op16_Zh` (`start`, not `lead`), `Stage2_DurRules` (the fall-through
    to the second rule).
  - Results:
    - byte-identical to TV_ENG32 on all 44 corpus files in the seven rate/format combinations, on 50 voice, rate,
      pitch and volume variants, and on the 102 test lines;
    - shadow mode: 0 mismatches over those inputs;
    - 503 of the 537 changed hunks run; the other 34 are unreachable through `tts_SaveFile`, or codegen only.
- [x] 5. The front end connected: the email context of `tts_SaveFile` (2026-09-29, REFERENCE §9.7).
  - `port/email.c`; `build.sh` links `src/frontend` into `tvsay.exe`.
  - Exact mode (`tvsay -0`, what `compare.py` runs unless `-f`): WAV byte-identical to TV_ENG32 on all the probe
    test lines in email context and on 54 of the 59 OpenTV corpus files. The engine's text (`compare.py -t`) is
    identical on 27,751 of the 28,734 fediff corpus inputs.
  - All remaining differences come from memory the original reads uninitialised (mostly `Tokenize_Dots`'s `prev`,
    which adds a sentence-end blank). fediff `-whole`, which supplies that memory, finds 0 mismatches on every one.
